summary: The agent attempts to train a single LightGBM model for a multi-output regression task without using a multi-output wrapper, which is fundamentally incompatible. Furthermore, the agent passes raw string columns (including complex chemical SMILES) directly to the model without any feature engineering or categorical encoding, which will cause immediate execution failures. Basic data cleaning is also completely skipped.
